name: Dot Matrix to Text Morph
composition: A grid of circular dots rearranging and expanding into crisp typography.
focal_point: Individual dots translating and scaling into letterform strokes.
layout_behavior: Centered brand or loading state hero element.
typography_characteristics: Bold geometric sans-serif logo or brand text.
choreography: Grid of circular dots rearranges over 1400ms and expands into letterform strokes.
why_it_works: Creates a memorable 'earned' brand reveal transition during splash screens or page initialization.

observed_properties.path_interpolation: SVG path morph or Lottie vector keyframes

inferred_design_principles.why_it_works: Creates a memorable 'earned' brand reveal transition during splash screens or page initialization.

implementation_recommendations.css_strategy: Best implemented via Lottie JSON export or GSAP MorphSVG Plugin for complex vector paths.
implementation_recommendations.lottie: Export Jitter template as Lottie JSON; trigger via `@dotlottie/react-player`.

portfolio_applications: Initial splash loader for high-craft portfolio case studies.
notes: Extracted from Jitter Morph template collection.

name: Animated Icon State Morph
composition: Single SVG icon morphing path shapes (e.g., Hamburger menu -> Close X icon, or Play -> Pause).
focal_point: Inner stroke lines rotating and scaling into new glyph form.
choreography: Inner stroke lines rotate 90deg and scale into target icon shape over 200ms.
why_it_works: Provides continuous physical identity between two mutually exclusive UI states.

inferred_design_principles.why_it_works: Provides continuous physical identity between two mutually exclusive UI states.

implementation_recommendations.css_strategy: CSS transition on `transform: rotate` + `opacity` between stacked SVG paths.
implementation_recommendations.framer_motion: Animate `d` path attribute or CSS rotate/scale transform.

portfolio_applications: Interactive menu toggles, search modals, and copy button confirmations.
notes: Extracted from Jitter Icon morphing templates.
